title: Yuminy Lightly Marinated Herring Pasta
description: A floral, light Malaysian dish featuring herring in a low-fat-friendly marinade and pasta combo, perfect for showcasing culinary skills.

ingredients.name: Cooking spray or olive oil for pasta

instructions: Sprinkle herring with low-fat soy sauce, lemon juice, sugar-free sweetener, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Arrange halved herring on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes or until the skin is crisp.
In a large pot, cook fettuccine pasta according to package instructions. Drain well when cooked.
While pasta cooks, mix marinated herring pieces in a bowl with a little olive oil and reserved cooking spray from pasta.
Toss the pasta mixture with the cooled herring for a quick and delightful meal.
Serve immediately and garnish if desired.
